title: Black Friday vacuum deals 2026: the Dyson, Shark and robot vacuums worth buying now
seoTitle: Black Friday Vacuum Deals 2026: Buy Now or Wait?
description: Which Dyson, Shark and robot vacuums are at real Black Friday lows, which 'was' prices to ignore, and the target prices worth paying in 2026.
intro:
**The best vacuum deal this Black Friday is the Dyson V8 at £199.99 on Amazon, matching its lowest price in six months, with the Dyson V12 Detect Slim at £349 at AO the pick for most homes.** Black Friday is on 27 November and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to Cyber Monday (30 November).

Dyson's cordless and wet floor cleaners are at genuine lows right now. Shark's PowerDetect range has gone back up at Amazon, and many robot vacuums are showing inflated 'was' prices. Prices below were published on 22 November (TechRadar) or read from PriceSpy on 23 November.

deals.name: Dyson V8 cordless vacuum
deals.note: Our budget pick. Which? puts its six-month low at £199 and its average at £342, so this is the real floor. Check which tools come in the box.

deals.name: Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute
deals.note: Our pick for most homes: light, with a dust-spotting laser and an anti-tangle head. £349 at AO, Currys and Very matches its lowest listed price on PriceSpy (Argos is £349.99).

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute
deals.note: More power and a bigger bin than the V12, worth it for pet owners and carpeted homes. £479 matches its lowest listed price; Which?'s six-month low is £468. Also at Currys and Very. More in our [Dyson V15 deals guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner
deals.note: For homes with mostly hard floors: it mops with clean water and collects the dirty water separately. TechRadar says it's never been this cheap.

deals.name: Dyson PencilWash wet floor cleaner
deals.note: A slimmer, lighter wet cleaner for kitchens and bathrooms. £179 at Amazon and AO is the bottom of its PriceSpy range.

deals.name: Eufy C28 Omni robot vacuum and mop
deals.note: A capable robot with a self-emptying, mop-washing dock. Ignore the £649 'was' price: it was £399 within the last three months, so hold out for that.

body:
## Why now?

Vacuums are one of the few big-ticket categories where Black Friday prices are usually real. Dyson in particular rarely discounts its own models outside November, and this year several have dropped to the lowest prices PriceSpy and Which? have tracked. Which?'s own vacuum deals check (22 November) puts the Dyson V8's six-month low at £199 and its average at £342, so today's £199.99 at Amazon is the real deal, not a marketing number.

The catch is that the deals aren't even. Dyson's cordless and wet cleaners are at lows. Shark's PowerDetect range, which was much cheaper earlier in the month, has drifted back up at Amazon. And robot vacuums are full of 'was' prices that nobody ever paid.

## Buy now

- **Dyson V8, £199.99 at Amazon.** The entry-level Dyson stick at its floor price. Fine for flats and smaller homes; less suction and a smaller bin than the V12 or V15.
- **Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene, £259 at Amazon.** TechRadar calls this its cheapest price by a long way. If you have mostly hard floors, a wet cleaner does more for how a kitchen looks than a better vacuum.
- **Dyson PencilWash, £179 at Amazon.** The slim wet cleaner, at the bottom of its PriceSpy range today.
- **Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute, £349 at AO.** It matches its lowest listed price and Which?'s six-month low (£350). It's the sweet spot for most homes: light, with a laser that shows up fine dust on hard floors.
- **Dyson V15 Detect Absolute, £479 at AO.** Also at its listed low. Only worth the extra over the V12 if you have pets or lots of carpet.

## Wait

- **Shark PowerDetect (IP1251UKT).** Amazon was charging £398.77 when we checked on 23 November, against a three-month low of £229. Unless that changes before Cyber Monday, don't buy at this price.
- **Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty (IP3251UKT).** £488 at Amazon today, against a low of £329.99. Same advice.
- **Most robot vacuums with a big 'was' price.** Roborock, Eufy and Ecovacs list reference prices hundreds of pounds above anything they've actually sold for. Judge them on PriceSpy history, not the percentage off.

## Target prices

These are the prices we'd be happy paying, based on PriceSpy and Which? data checked on 22 and 23 November:

- Dyson V8: £199 or less
- Dyson V12 Detect Slim: about £350
- Dyson V15 Detect Absolute: under £480
- Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene: under £260
- Shark PowerDetect: about £230 to £260 (not today's price)
- Eufy C28 Omni robot: £399 (it has been there in the last three months; £449 today)
- Roborock Q7 L5+ self-emptying robot: about £160

## How to choose

**Cordless or corded?** Cordless sticks have won for most homes: lighter, quicker to grab and good enough for weekly cleans. A corded cylinder (a Henry, for example) still makes sense for big houses with lots of carpet, since it never runs flat.

**Battery life.** Real-world runtime on normal power is usually 30 to 60 minutes, and much less on boost. For a three-bedroom house with carpet, look for a model with a swappable or larger battery.

**Pets.** Look for an anti-tangle brush bar. Both Dyson (on the V12 and up) and Shark have them, and they save you cutting hair off the roller every week.

**Wet cleaners.** If most of your floors are hard, a wet-and-dry cleaner like the Clean+Wash or PencilWash can replace both the vacuum and the mop for daily jobs. They aren't for carpet.

**Robots.** A robot is for keeping floors tidy between proper cleans, not replacing a stick. Self-emptying bases are worth paying for; mopping docks are nice but add cost and maintenance.

Still choosing between the two big names? Our [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) comparison goes into detail, and the [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) track each brand.

## Check before you buy

Paste the exact model into PriceSpy to see what it has really sold for. Model codes matter: Dyson sells several V8 and V15 bundles with different tools, and Which? warns that some sale V8 bundles come with only a crevice tool. Buy from the retailer itself rather than a marketplace seller, and register the product for the warranty. For everything else on sale this week, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
